data_flow: During an enrolment lifecycle: 1. `POST /control-plane/pairing-codes` inserts a row into `gateway_pairing_codes` with `code_hash = sha256(code)` and an event into `gateway_registry_events` with `event_type = 'minted'`, `gateway_id = null`, and `pairing_id` set (`packages/control-plane/src/gateway/store.ts` lines 145-168). Because the `minted` event is committed immediately, it always owes a `gateway.code_minted` row in `/07-decisions/ops-actions-log.md` on the same calendar day, even if the code is never redeemed and later expires (`docs/planning/command-journal/custody/FOUNDER-AUTHORIZATION-pc-gateway-enrollment-20261013.txt` line 21 clause B7: "An unredeemed code is left to expire"). 2. `buildroom enroll` on the gateway machine acquires `stagingLockPath`, verifies `hasUnresolvedStaging(state)` is false and `inventory.staging` is false, reads the pairing code from stdin, generates the Ed25519 keypair, stores the private key in `staging` custody, sets `staging.lane` to `PENDING_REDEEM`, and calls `POST /gateway/enroll` (`packages/gateway-cli/src/enroll.ts` lines 69-192). 3. `GatewayRegistryStore.redeem` (`packages/control-plane/src/gateway/store.ts` lines 515-670) checks `gateway_redeem_idempotency`, validates `code_hash` against `gateway_pairing_codes`, atomically sets `consumed_at` and `consumed_by_gateway_id`, writes a `key_received` event (`actor: gatewayActor(gatewayId)`) into `gateway_registry_events`, upserts `gateway_current_state` with `state = 'awaiting_approval'` and `awaiting_approval_expires_at`, and returns `202` with `{ gatewayId, keyId, fingerprint, awaitingApprovalExpiresAt }`. `key_received` is a gateway-actor machine event, not a Founder act, so it owes no row in `/07-decisions/ops-actions-log.md` (`docs/gateway-ops-actions-log-runbook.md` lines 33-44). 4. On `POST /control-plane/enrollments/:gatewayId/confirm`, `/deny`, or `POST /control-plane/gateways/:gatewayId/revoke`, a `409` refusal (`fingerprint_mismatch`, `not_awaiting_approval`, `enrollment_cap_reached`) writes a diagnostic row to `gateway_enrollment_refusals` (`store.ts` lines 247-303, 349-353, 391-414) and writes no Founder act event (`enrolled`, `denied`, `revoked`) to `gateway_registry_events` (except that when `awaiting_approval_expires_at <= now`, `recordExpiry` writes a machine `expired` event with `actor: controlPlaneActor('expiry')` at `store.ts` lines 273-274, 406, 442-461). Only a committed `201` confirm or `200` deny/revoke writes a Founder event (`enrolled`, `denied`, `revoked`) to `gateway_registry_events` and owes a corresponding row in `/07-decisions/ops-actions-log.md`.

error_and_failure_behavior: The planned `## Troubleshooting` section in `docs/gateway-ops-actions-log-runbook.md` will specify the exact cause, database effect, ops-log obligation, and recovery/stop action for each failure class: 1. Gateway CLI pre-redemption and redemption errors (`packages/gateway-cli/src/enroll.ts` lines 59-226, `packages/control-plane/src/gateway/store.ts` lines 515-614): (a) `staging_busy_or_recovery_required`: `acquireStagingLock` found an existing lock at `stagingLockPath` before reading the code or generating a keypair; run `buildroom doctor` to check whether `pid` is `live` (wait for it) or `not live` (`stopCondition: true`; stop all gateway CLI and daemon processes before out-of-band Founder lock cleanup; the pairing code was not read or consumed). (b) `staging_enrollment_unresolved`: `state.staging.lane` is not `INACTIVE` or a staging custody item already exists; a second `buildroom enroll` is never a recovery path; inspect `lanes` and `staging inventory` with `buildroom doctor`. (c) Custody probe/inventory failure (`custody is unavailable` in `enroll.ts` line 107, `unknown (custody unavailable)` in `doctor.ts` line 130): check the OS credential store (macOS Keychain `/usr/bin/security` or Linux `systemd-creds`); `enroll` fails closed before reading the code or generating a key. (d) `redeem_refused`: `POST /gateway/enroll` returned a terminal refusal (`400 invalid_request`, `400 malformed_pubkey`, `409 unknown_code`, `409 code_expired`, `409 code_consumed`, or `409 idempotency_key_mismatch`); `enroll` deletes the staging custody item and resets `staging.lane` to `INACTIVE` (`enroll.ts` lines 194-207). Note that pairing codes are 43-character base64url strings (`store.ts` lines 141-145), case-sensitive with trim-only canonicalization (`enroll-validation.ts` lines 78-84), and expire after `GATEWAY_CODE_TTL_MS` (default `600_000` ms = 10 minutes, max `900_000` ms = 15 minutes in `packages/control-plane/src/config.ts` lines 338-339). If a minted code expires unredeemed (`code_expired` or left unredeemed after a stop), the `minted` event in `gateway_registry_events` already occurred and still owes its `gateway.code_minted` row in `/07-decisions/ops-actions-log.md`. (e) `redeem_horizon_elapsed`: transport or retryable errors persisted across the 24-hour `REDEEM_RETRY_HORIZON_MS` window (`lanes.ts` line 26, `enroll.ts` lines 210-226); staging custody is retained (`TRANSPORT_RETRY`) and surfaced by `buildroom doctor`. 2. Founder-endpoint HTTP errors (`packages/control-plane/src/gateway/routes.ts` lines 214-322, `store.ts` lines 240-462, `server.ts` lines 426-506): (a) `401 unauthorized`: missing, malformed, or wrong `Authorization` header against `CONTROL_PLANE_TOKEN` (`server.ts` lines 482-506); rejected before body parsing; no registry event written; no ops-log row owed. (b) `400 invalid_request` / `413 payload_too_large`: non-UUID `gatewayId`, `fingerprint` not 64 lowercase hex characters (`routes.ts` lines 260-271, 311-315), malformed JSON, or body over `16kb` (`GATEWAY_BODY_LIMIT`); no registry event written; no ops-log row owed. (c) `404 not_found`: `gatewayId` not in `gateway_current_state` (`store.ts` lines 243, 381); verify `GET /control-plane/enrollments` and confirm `buildroom enroll` completed redemption (`202`); no registry event written; no ops-log row owed. (d) `409 fingerprint_mismatch`: stored public key's `sha256` does not match presented `fingerprint` (`store.ts` lines 245-255); refusal recorded in `gateway_enrollment_refusals`, gateway stays `awaiting_approval`, no `enrolled` event written; per `FOUNDER-AUTHORIZATION-pc-gateway-enrollment-20261013.txt` line 17 (B5), do not confirm — deny the enrollment via `POST /control-plane/enrollments/:gatewayId/deny`, record the `gateway.enrollment_denied` row (with the `denied` event's `event_id`), and stop. (e) `409 not_awaiting_approval`: returned when confirming or denying a gateway whose `state` is not `awaiting_approval`, when `awaiting_approval_expires_at <= now` (`GATEWAY_AWAITING_APPROVAL_TTL_MS`, default 1 hour), or when calling `POST /control-plane/gateways/:gatewayId/revoke` on a gateway whose `state` is not `enrolled` (`store.ts` lines 257-283, 369-415). Check `GET /control-plane/enrollments` to inspect current `state` and `awaitingApprovalExpiresAt`. If lazy expiry fired during confirm/deny (`store.ts` lines 273-282, 401-415), `recordExpiry` wrote a machine `expired` event (`actor: controlPlaneActor('expiry')`, `store.ts` lines 442-461) and a `not_awaiting_approval` refusal row; `expired` is a control-plane expiry, not a Founder act, and enrolling the gateway after expiry requires a new Founder act to mint a fresh pairing code and re-run `buildroom enroll`. (f) `409 enrollment_cap_reached`: both slots (`1` and `2` in `gateway_current_state.enrollment_slot`) are held (`store.ts` lines 290-304). Refusal is recorded in `gateway_enrollment_refusals` and gateway stays `awaiting_approval` (no `enrolled` event written yet). When replacing an incumbent while both slots are held (`docs/gateway-ops-actions-log-runbook.md` lines 125-128), revoke the incumbent first (`POST /control-plane/gateways/:gatewayId/revoke`), then confirm the successor before `awaitingApprovalExpiresAt`, and record both Founder acts (`gateway.gateway_revoked` and `gateway.enrollment_confirmed`) in `/07-decisions/ops-actions-log.md`.
